description_en: Queries the deployment, upgrade, and application logs of a service instance
description_zh: 调用ListServiceInstanceLogs查询服务实例的部署，升级和应用等日志
kebab_example: aliyun computenestsupplier list-service-instance-logs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-instance-id si-70a3b15bb626435b0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListServiceInstanceLogs

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page for paging during a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页行数。其中最大值为100行，默认值为20行
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set the value to the NextToken value returned from the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The log source. Valid values:

application: logs generated by the application.

computeNest: logs generated by Compute Nest.

ros: logs generated by Resource Orchestration Service (ROS)
parameters.help_zh:
日志来源。可选值：

application：应用自身的日志。

computeNest：计算巢打印的日志。

ros：来自资源编排的日志
parameters.name: log_source

parameters.help_en: The name of the Logstore in Simple Log Service
parameters.name: logstore

fields.help_en:
The name of the filter condition. Valid values:

StartTime
EndTime
ApplicationGroupName
ResouceName
EventName
fields.help_zh:
过滤值名称。

可选值：
StartTime
EndTime
ApplicationGroupName
ResouceName
EventName
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The value of the filter condition
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

Ascending: ascending order
Descending: descending order

Default value: Descending
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。取值范围：

Ascending：升序
Descending（默认值）：降序
parameters.name: sort_order

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned per page for paging during a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
MaxResults.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的行数。每页最大100行，默认为20行

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next query

CompliancePackType.description_en: The risk type of the compliance pack. This parameter is returned when Source is set to compliancePack. Example: VpcDataRisk, which indicates a data security check in a VPC
CompliancePackType.description_zh: 合规包风险类型，当source为compliancePack时出现。如VPC内数据安全检查，VpcDataRisk

ComplianceRuleName.description_en: The name of the specific risk rule in the compliance pack. This parameter is returned when Source is set to compliancePack. Example: vpc-ecs-move-out-vpc, which indicates an ECS instance migration out of a VPC
ComplianceRuleName.description_zh: 合规包具体风险规则名，当source为compliancePack时出现。如ECS实例迁移出vpc-ecs-move-out-vpc

LogType.description_en:
The log type. Valid values:

serviceInstance: logs generated at the service instance level.

resource: logs generated at the ROS resource level
LogType.description_zh:
日志类型。可能的值：

serviceInstance：服务实例层级产生的日志。

resource：ROS资源层级产生的日志

Source.description_en:
The source of the service instance log. Valid values:

ros: logs generated by Resource Orchestration Service (ROS).

computeNest: logs generated by Compute Nest.

application: logs generated by the application in the instance.

compliancePack: logs generated by the compliance pack of the instance.

actionTrail: logs generated by ActionTrail
Source.description_zh:
服务实例日志的来源。可能的值：

ros：来源于资源编排ROS的日志。

computeNest：来源于计算巢的日志。
application: 来源于实例内应用日志
compliancePack: 来源于实例合规检测包的日志
actionTrail: 来源于操作审计

Status.description_en:
The log status. Valid values:

Creating: creating

Created: created

Deploying: deploying

Deployed: deployed

DeployedFailed: deployment failed

Expired: expired

ExtendSuccess: renewal succeeded

Upgrading: upgrading

UpgradeSuccess: upgrade succeeded
Status.description_zh:
日志状态。可能的值：

Creating：创建中。

Created：已创建。

Deploying：部署中。

Deployed：已部署。

DeployedFailed：部署失败。

Expired：已过期。

ExtendSuccess：续费成功。

Upgrading：升级中。

UpgradeSuccess：升级成功

Timestamp.description_en: The timestamp of the service instance log
Timestamp.description_zh: 服务实例日志的时间戳
